def age_of_universe(H0):
    """A Hubble constant in km/s per Mpc, turned into an age in billions of years."""
    MPC_IN_KM = 3.0857e19
    SECONDS_PER_YEAR = 60 * 60 * 24 * 365.25
    seconds = MPC_IN_KM / H0
    return seconds / SECONDS_PER_YEAR / 1e9
